_comment: Guided tour of the QuEst window (the plugin window and the Structure Tools card share it). Steps point at real controls and wait for the user to press them; targets are the window's control names and the attrs of quest.view.json. Load example ships its own structure, so the tour can be walked without the user's files.

steps.title: What QuEst simulates
steps.text:
A dye tethered to a protein by a flexible linker wanders over the surface; where it meets a quenching residue (Trp, Tyr, His, Met, Pro) its fluorescence is quenched by photo-induced electron transfer (PET), and with a second dye it can also transfer energy by FRET. QuEst simulates that diffusion from the structure alone and gives you the decay you would measure.

You press the buttons; the tour only points at them.

steps.title: Start from the demo
steps.text: Load example loads T4 lysozyme (PDB 148L), puts the dye on the Cβ of Ser 36 and sets a short run. It ships with ChiSurf, so nothing has to be downloaded. With your own structure use Load PDB... instead; a valid attachment site is picked for you.

steps.title: Where the dye sits
steps.text: Chain, residue and atom of the attachment point, usually the Cβ of the labelled residue. Change the residue to compare sites.

steps.title: The accessible volume
steps.text: Linker length, linker width and dye radius define where the dye centre can be. A longer linker reaches more quenchers. At the default width (4.5 Å) some surface sites have no volume at all; a narrower width labels them.

steps.title: Simulate
steps.text: QuEst walks the dye through its volume and races photons against the quenching rate along the walk. The state line shows the quantum yield and the mean lifetime when it is done.

await.hint: Press Simulate and wait for the state line to show QY.

steps.title: Read the decay
steps.text: Plots & Dynamics shows the simulated decay, the dye's distance from its mean position along the trajectory and how fast the dye forgets where it was. QY is relative to the unquenched dye: 1 means no quenching. Run twice with different seeds: if QY moves, lengthen the simulation.

steps.title: The chemistry
steps.text: Quenching Chemistry lists the quenching rate, contact radius, atoms and stickiness of each amino acid. They are reference values; edit a cell to test another assumption.

steps.title: Save the project
steps.text: Save project... writes the form as a project file: the file the quest command line and the RPC methods run. Press Help for every parameter.
